integrity: Analytic proof with exact rational Bernstein certificate, independently reconstructible Fourier tests; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the L-stable gamma=2-sqrt(2) TR-BDF2 end-step on a symmetric unit-rate heat cycle with n>=3, not arbitrary Markov generators, nonuniform grids, stagewise positivity, or accuracy guarantees.
title: Sharp seven-vertex positivity cutoff and reentrant TR-BDF2 heat stepping on cycles
